author_identity.context_statement: Only the author task instructions and the one allowed normative brief were exposed as substantive task material.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: Field-bound literal title containing a Boolean-looking word, rating floor, explicit author and canonical category exclusion.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Quoted title is literal; title text does not imply category membership. Four resolved conjunctive requirements are enforceable.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: Ordered catalogue selection recipe: select canonical category, constrain author and online format, then order title.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Positive canonical category, explicit author and online format are supported in every scope; catalogue sorting is a search operation.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: Exact-title search with a positive canonical category, whole-word text exclusion and an optional presentation preference.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Broad whole-word exclusion differs from canonical category exclusion; optional illustrated presentation never filters.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: Category-first request with one transposed category spelling and independently explicit author, rating and title order.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Unique canonical category repair is executable with a notice grounded in that scope canonical list.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: Acceptance checklist separates a literal title, positive category, misspelled negative category and optional maps.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: The negative category spelling has one safe canonical repair; negative category ownership remains explicit.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: Reader need expressed as an online selection bounded by rating and word exclusion, with a repaired domain label and soft audience preference.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Repair only the explicit category operand; keep the text exclusion broad and the beginner preference advisory.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: Two quoted operands have explicitly undecided author/title assignment, while rating and sorting are fixed.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Both hard field operands are unresolved because their owner assignment is expressly withheld; plausible name appearance is not evidence.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: A stated exclusion has explicitly undecided mandatory/advisory status beside resolved author/format and another definite preference.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Unresolved hard/advisory ownership prevents execution even when the text operand itself is known.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: A required single canonical category is pending a choice between two named categories; union is explicitly disclaimed.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Unknown mandatory category choice is ambiguity, not permission to invent an OR operation or search both.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: A quoted empty title field is mandatory beside explicit author, rating floor and category exclusion.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: A blank required title is incomplete; the other resolved constraints remain gold.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: A saved catalogue form specifies category/format/order but explicitly leaves its required author box empty.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Missing required author is incomplete and may not be silently dropped.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: A delivery-mode selection is explicitly unfilled beside a literal title, whole-word exclusion and an optional visual preference.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: An empty required format remains incomplete even where the scope supports only online material; capabilities do not supply user input.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: Strict exclusive category membership requests XOR, including rejection of records in both named categories.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Ordinary category keywords do not license exclusive Boolean operations. Resolved XOR operands are documented without fabricating an AND/OR hard filter.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: Literal author/title and online format coexist with a strict regular-expression description exclusion.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: An arbitrary anchored digit-pattern exclusion is not the supported broad whole-word text exclusion.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: A strict negative jacket-color field accompanies supported category/rating/order and an advisory content preference.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Cover color is not an enforceable capability in any supplied contract; do not reduce it to an unrelated whole-word text exclusion.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: Resolved strict and inclusive rating bounds share the same endpoint beside exact bibliographic fields, online format and order.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Rating at least four and below four has empty intersection; neither bound may be discarded.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: One explicitly canonical category is simultaneously required and prohibited, with independently literal author/title.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Positive and negative membership in the same canonical category is a direct contradiction, independent of catalogue facts.

pattern_specs.semantic_structure: The same whole word is explicitly required and prohibited in the same searchable-text domain beside title/format/order and optional diagrams.
pattern_specs.normative_rule: Opposed whole-word predicates over the same domain contradict; soft preferences cannot repair them.

construction_rules: Eighteen semantic patterns were composed from the normative brief, then mechanically instantiated into five explicit scope contexts; these are shared groups, not ninety independently invented grammars.
All meaningful requested operations are declared in operation_topology. No inert modifiers were added to obtain a topology.
Explicit exact author/title operands are literal query constraints. No bibliography existence or author/title association was looked up or inferred.
The public/global category pair is History/Physics; the private pair is Neural Networks/Detective Fiction. All are supplied canonical subjects.
Safe repairs use only an explicit category operand and one unique supplied canonical spelling; notice gold points to its brief source.
All format requests with a value are ONLINE, supported in every scope. Blank required format remains missing even in GLOBAL.

Hard constraints contain resolved, expressible operands only; unresolved required operands are omitted and masked UNRESOLVED. Unsupported operations keep their resolved operands under expected_unsupported without fabricating supported replacements.
Resolved contradictory predicates remain in hard gold rather than deleting one side.
Absent hard fields are explicit in expected_absent_hard_fields and APPLICABLE in masks; absence of unsupported replacement filters is separately explained.
Soft semantic preferences are independently authored content, not a commitment to a parser-specific advisory object schema; structured advisory/actor metrics are N/A where no oracle exists.
No case was relabeled from predictions. Every desired stratum was judged semantically feasible; separate fresh review remains mandatory.

hard_constraints.author: exact string object
hard_constraints.title: exact string object
hard_constraints.rating: resolved bound operators, including both sides of a contradiction

gold_schema.empty_diagnostic_arrays: The corresponding issue is absent, not unknown.
gold_schema.semantic_remainder: Non-hard preference meanings; no additional free-text hard content is silently inferred.
gold_schema.notice_matching: Semantic repair and source are gold; exact notice wording is not prescribed.

exact_reads.purpose: Read the one authorized normative brief
SHA256 of the exact authorized brief bytes only; contents not parsed

execution_disclosure: One PowerShell read tool invocation and one PowerShell-hosted Python standard-library serialization/materialization invocation. json.dumps is output serialization; no JSON input parser or search parser was run. No separate model/API inference, catalogue, database, native application, or test execution occurred.
